title: butea purpurea
intro: Butea purpurea, commonly known as Red Kwath or Siris, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of South Asia. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to treat various health conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Butea purpurea include its use as an antiseptic, diuretic, and expectorant, making it effective in treating respiratory issues and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
